authored_models.95: Two-state electronic expectation and angle-constraint CP-type Euler-Lagrange equations derived explicitly in THEORY.md; primary paper abstract is historical context, not source of this exact toy model.
authored_models.98_99: Analytic normalized s-Gaussian integral formulas adapted from existing MIT atlas source, same explicit stored H STO-3G values. Added <=3-center/two-electron HF/FCI/MP2 code is original; finite-basis and independent-assembly limits explicit.
authored_models.101: Original finite3-plane-wave local Fourier plus rank-one nonlocal kernel and Fermi free-energy model. Not DFTK/PySCF code or a real-element PSP. The fixed N=1.5 is the mean particle number of independent-particle Fermi occupations, not an integer-particle canonical many-body distribution.

independence_limits: 96/100 are immutable saved-data audits, not reexecution or independent new reference generation.
98 uses only two saved PySCF RHF rows. No saved UHF/FCI values are invented. Analytic two-AO H2 oracles and separate fermion assembly qualify new code.

99 has no independently regenerated PySCF scalar. It uses analytic primitive identities, H2 cached integral/SCF qualification, independent second-quantized FCI assembly and MP2 determinant perturbation identity. These are distinct from an independent external quantum-chemistry engine.
95 RK4 companions are a different integrator for the same explicit model; step-sensitivity is not a formal global-error certificate.
101 cubic spectral oracle and matrix derivatives qualify the finite declared Hamiltonian, not discretization convergence or a real metal.
